pullRequests.title: Release launcher 1.1.0
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: release/1.1.0
pullRequests.body:
Launcher 1.1.0 from develop: the 249 pull requests merged since 1.0.2, with the version in Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock (launcher, core and iOS crates), package.json and tauri.conf.json, and launcher/release-notes/1.1.0.md.
Mod SDK 1.20.0 (sdk/VERSION on develop) is released with it. After merging, launcher-v1.1.0 and sdk-v1.20.0 are tagged on this PR's merge commit.
🤖 Generated with Claude Code
